title: SU(5) matter and adjoint-vacuum benchmark
question: Can separate tool-using explorer and vacuum agents reproduce a known embedding and a qualified tree-level scalar vacuum analysis?

scope.scalars: one real adjoint 24; electroweak Higgs deferred

tasks: Derive exact branchings, net chirality, and local anomaly cancellation.
Hand off a versioned candidate from explorer to vacuum.
Compute both VEV stabilizers and investigate a renormalizable adjoint potential.
Separate singlet existence, stationarity, boundedness, local stability, and global minimality.
Rerun saved calculations and preserve failures and unresolved checks.
acceptance: Exact rational charges and dimension checks.
Explicit evidence files for every reported check.
An unsuitable VEV control is recognized.
Results can be reproduced independently of subagent conversation state.
